import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    lookback_30 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    lookback_90 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    lookback_180 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)
    lookback_365 = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=365)

    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]

    relevant_items = order_items[order_items["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)]
    items_full = relevant_items.merge(
        orders[["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp", "order_status"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left",
    )
    # Только покупки, совершённые до seed_time
    items_historic = items_full[items_full["order_purchase_timestamp"] <= seed_time].copy()

    def agg_window(df, suffix):
        if len(df) == 0:
            return pd.DataFrame({
                "product_id": pd.Series(dtype=object),
                f"units_sold_{suffix}": pd.Series(dtype=float),
                f"revenue_{suffix}": pd.Series(dtype=float),
                f"avg_price_{suffix}": pd.Series(dtype=float),
                f"total_freight_{suffix}": pd.Series(dtype=float),
                f"unique_orders_{suffix}": pd.Series(dtype=float),
                f"unique_buyers_{suffix}": pd.Series(dtype=float),
            })
        out = df.groupby("product_id").agg(
            **{
                f"units_sold_{suffix}": ("order_item_id", "count"),
                f"revenue_{suffix}": ("price", "sum"),
                f"avg_price_{suffix}": ("price", "mean"),
                f"total_freight_{suffix}": ("freight_value", "sum"),
                f"unique_orders_{suffix}": ("order_id", "nunique"),
                f"unique_buyers_{suffix}": ("price", "size"),
            }
        ).reset_index()
        return out

    windows = {
        "30d": lookback_30,
        "90d": lookback_90,
        "180d": lookback_180,
        "365d": lookback_365,
    }
    aggs = []
    for suffix, start in windows.items():
        w = items_historic[items_historic["order_purchase_timestamp"] > start]
        aggs.append(agg_window(w, suffix))

    # Полнота истории
    total_units = items_historic.groupby("product_id")["order_item_id"].count().rename("units_total")

    # Recency
    last_purchase = items_historic.groupby("product_id")["order_purchase_timestamp"].max()
    first_purchase = items_historic.groupby("product_id")["order_purchase_timestamp"].min()
    recency = ((seed_time - last_purchase).dt.days).rename("recency_days")
    age_days = ((seed_time - first_purchase).dt.days).rename("history_days")

    # Отзывы: используем только те, что УЖЕ созданы к моменту seed_time
    reviews_avail = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] <= seed_time][["order_id", "review_score"]]
    items_reviews = items_historic[["order_id", "product_id"]].merge(
        reviews_avail, on="order_id", how="inner"
    )
    review_agg = items_reviews.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_review=("review_score", "mean"),
        total_reviews=("review_score", "count"),
        min_review=("review_score", "min"),
    ).reset_index()

    # Свежие отзывы (за 90 дней до seed_time)
    rev_90 = items_reviews.merge(
        reviews[["order_id", "review_creation_date"]], on="order_id", how="left"
    )
    rev_90 = rev_90[rev_90["review_creation_date"] > lookback_90]
    review_90_agg = rev_90.groupby("product_id").agg(
        avg_review_90=("review_score", "mean"),
        n_reviews_90=("review_score", "count"),
    ).reset_index()

    final_features = pd.DataFrame({"product_id": list(entity_ids)})

    for agg in aggs:
        final_features = final_features.merge(agg, on="product_id", how="left")
    for ser, name in [(total_units, "units_total"), (recency, "recency_days"), (age_days, "history_days")]:
        final_features = final_features.merge(ser.rename(name).reset_index(), on="product_id", how="left")
    final_features = final_features.merge(review_agg, on="product_id", how="left")
    final_features = final_features.merge(review_90_agg, on="product_id", how="left")

    # Производные признаки
    if "units_sold_90" in final_features and "units_sold_180" in final_features:
        final_features["sales_accel_90_180"] = (
            final_features["units_sold_90"] / 90.0
            - final_features["units_sold_180"] / 180.0
        )
    if "units_sold_30" in final_features:
        final_features["sales_accel_30_90"] = (
            final_features["units_sold_30"] / 30.0
            - final_features["units_sold_90"] / 90.0
        )
    final_features["review_gap_90"] = final_features["avg_review_90"] - final_features["avg_review"]

    fill_zero_cols = [
        "units_sold_30d", "revenue_30d", "avg_price_30d", "total_freight_30d",
        "unique_orders_30d", "unique_buyers_30d",
        "units_sold_90d", "revenue_90d", "avg_price_90d", "total_freight_90d",
        "unique_orders_90d", "unique_buyers_90d",
        "units_sold_180d", "revenue_180d", "avg_price_180d", "total_freight_180d",
        "unique_orders_180d", "unique_buyers_180d",
        "units_sold_365d", "revenue_365d", "avg_price_365d", "total_freight_365d",
        "unique_orders_365d", "unique_buyers_365d",
        "units_total", "avg_review", "total_reviews", "min_review",
        "avg_review_90", "n_reviews_90",
        "sales_accel_90_180", "sales_accel_30_90", "review_gap_90",
    ]
    for col in fill_zero_cols:
        if col in final_features.columns:
            final_features[col] = final_features[col].fillna(0)

    final_features["recency_days"] = final_features["recency_days"].fillna(3650)
    final_features["history_days"] = final_features["history_days"].fillna(0)

    final_features = final_features.set_index("product_id")
    final_features = final_features.reindex(entity_ids)
    final_features = final_features.fillna(0).astype(float)

    return final_features
